title: A kinematic explanation of the 1:3 ratio for rolling spheres and the exceptional simple Lie group of rank two
summary: Given a pair of (round) 2-dimensional spheres, one of which has radius three times that of the other, the Lie algebra of local infinitesimal symmetries for the distribution corresponding to rolling the spheres along each other (without letting them slip or twist) happens to be isomorphic to the split real form of the exceptional simple Lie algebra of rank 2.
